svg.title: Payment lifecycle
svg.desc: On the checkout, an order created with a payment_complete_url sends payment.redirected, and the shopper is redirected there to pay; no order.created comes. Paid, the gateway redirects the shopper to the next page, which loads the order (order.loaded, then order.paid once) and empties the cart kept for it. Not paid, the gateway redirects the shopper back to the checkout with payment_failed=true: payment.failed, once per order, with the cart kept and the same checkout. A shopper who comes back without paying, such as with the Back button, gets the checkout again without events.

text.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

g.text: paid: redirected to the next page

path.style: fill: none; stroke: var(--clean-fg-muted, #6b7280); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 5 4

text.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)
fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)
fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: payment.redirected comes on the checkout before the shopper leaves; order.created does not come
The next page is next-success-url (else /success): order.loaded, then order.paid once per order
payment.failed: once per order, where the URL has payment_failed=true; the order is not loaded
Back on the checkout: the same checkout and cart, no checkout.started; a new submit is a new order
Back from the gateway without paying (the Back button): the checkout again, without events

tspan.style: fill: var(--color-rose-500, #e11d48); font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: → on the next page: no order.loaded or order.paid; the cart is kept
